description: This PHP class 'IntArray' is a validation rule that checks whether a given input is an array of integers. It extends an abstract class 'AbstractRule' and implements a 'validate' method to perform the check.

classes.name: IntArray
classes.description: A validation rule class that verifies if the input is an array composed solely of integer values.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Checks if the input is an array of integers; returns true if valid, false otherwise.
